parallel.requirements: Recognized the black-box port, Rust 2021, zero dependency, Cargo layout, root test17.rs, CLI defaults, exact YUV/RGB/HSL behavior, and byte-for-byte stdout formatting requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent retained implementation, integration, verification, and delivery ownership while delegating numeric formula inference to infer_formula and stdout formatting investigation to check_formatting.
parallel.implementation: Parent created Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/color.rs, src/formatting.rs, and test17.rs, then patched rgb_to_hsl after oracle mismatch and the formula child's returned findings.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Parent integrated child findings into a single project, built release artifacts, copied target/release/test17 to /output/test17, and left the required root source and library files.
parallel.verification: Parent ran cargo build, cargo test, targeted oracle examples, and a 500-case oracle comparison that returned validated before final response; official evaluation later passed 39/39.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished or incorrect deliverable is visible at closure; a transient local mismatch was corrected before final validation and evaluation.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same black-box constraints, CLI defaults, exact numeric behavior, C++ stream formatting, zero external dependencies, Cargo layout, and root test17.rs delivery.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single agent owned the whole pipeline, using a sequential plan for probing, implementation, compilation, oracle comparison, correction, cleanup, and final response.
serial.implementation: Serial created Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/color.rs, src/formatter.rs, and test17.rs, then patched HSL branch and operation order after disassembly and mismatch analysis.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Serial kept all writes local to one actor, compiled both the cargo release binary and /output/test17, removed a stray standalone artifact, and delivered the final project tree.
serial.verification: Serial ran example comparisons, a 3,375-case grid sweep with DIFFS=0, cargo build --release, and final artifact listings; official evaluation later passed 39/39.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished or incorrect deliverable is visible at closure; earlier precision mismatches were ordinary implementation iteration and were fixed before final validation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the prompt's Rust 2021, CLI, exact logic/formatting, zero-dependency, Cargo layout, black-box, and output placement requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and recognized the same obligations, including exact byte-for-byte stdout and the required /output/test17.rs entry.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement coverage gap; the difference is that parallel delegated parts of discovery while serial handled discovery in one thread.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel launched infer_formula and check_formatting while the parent kept the implementation and delivery path.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial created an explicit single-agent todo plan covering probing, implementation, and verification with no delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel decomposed research into two children; serial did equivalent work sequentially, so there was no ownership gap.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children had enough context to return usable findings: formatting warned against Rust Display, and formula inference returned formulas that reproduced sampled outputs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all context in one thread, moving from samples to precision and disassembly checks without handoff boundaries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced handoff boundaries but they were concise and usable; serial avoided handoffs entirely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent created the Rust project, used a custom formatter, saw a saturation mismatch, and patched HSL branch logic and operation order.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial created the Rust project, found small precision mismatches, inspected the executable's disassembly, and patched the HSL implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both converged on equivalent behavior; serial spent more effort proving the compiled arithmetic path, while parallel used child findings plus oracle feedback.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The formatting child returned first and the formula child returned later; the parent received both and acted after the later result arrived.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle because multi-agent execution was disabled and all findings stayed in the main session.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a temporary wait timeout, but it then inspected agent state, received the formula result, and used it; serial had no join risk.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent performed the file additions and later patch itself; the children investigated and reported rather than writing competing implementation files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had one writer for all source files and removed a stray standalone artifact before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had shared workspace exposure but no observed write collision, overwrite, artifact leakage, or provenance instability; serial was simpler by construction.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran cargo build, cargo test, oracle examples, and a 500-case oracle comparison, then the official evaluator passed 39/39.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran cargo build, targeted example comparisons, a 3,375-case grid with DIFFS=0, and then the official evaluator passed 39/39.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial's local sweep was broader, but both had evaluator-aligned acceptance evidence and both official evaluations passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed within budget, did not time out, and closed after validating and copying the final executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also completed within budget and closed after cleanup, validation, and final artifact inspection.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used more LLM requests and tokens because of child work but finished faster wall-clock; neither run left closure work unfinished.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome: both current completed status.json evaluation records passed all 39 test cases. Parallel success came through parent-owned implementation aided by two returned child research results; serial success came through one-thread probing, implementation, disassembly-guided correction, and broad grid validation.
parallel_contributors: The parent received and used the formatting and formula child results, patched the HSL logic, and validated against the oracle before final delivery.
serial_contributors: The serial agent sequentially performed probing, disassembly, patching, cleanup, and a 3,375-case DIFFS=0 verification before final delivery.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel initially used an algebraically simplified saturation formula that failed some oracle comparisons, then corrected it.
Serial also had precision-level mismatches after its first implementation, then used disassembly to mirror the compiled routine.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; process strategy differs but final official correctness is equivalent
